summary: Classifies tracked .aide material so generated/export/report state cannot become product authority.

areas.meaning: repo operating metadata and AIDE Lite law/config only
portable export bundle; not active source
small tracked cache metadata only; bulk local cache must stay ignored
generated repo maps and inventories; cap or archive if volume grows
generated root classifications; cap or archive if volume grows
generated tool inventories; cap or archive if volume grows

hard_rules: .aide/export is export-only and must not be imported as active source.
Product truth remains in contracts, runtime, surfaces, site source, docs, and accepted architecture docs as applicable.
non_claims: AIDE Lite does not own product semantics.
AIDE generated/export/report files are not runtime behavior.
This policy does not enable provider/model/network calls.
